fusions.name: Handed Along
fusions.desc: Tosses a polyp that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then passes to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Prised Open
fusions.desc: Pries at the target, dealing 18 damage and drawing out every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, then leaves it [Weakened] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: Cleaner polyps pick up to 3 conditions off you and restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Sleight of Frond
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
